name: How I became the CEO's darling
original_name: How I became the CEO's darling
overview: As the adopted daughter of the Getty family, Emily endured a lifetime of mistreatment. A single act of unintentional protection from Thomas kept her by his side for years—until the engagement banquet, where he stood by as others humiliated her. That night, she finally gave up on him and married Lyle in a flash wedding. Over time, Lyle’s unwavering care healed her insecurities, and she realized he had secretly loved her for the past ten years.
